7.4.60<7.4.59.reason: 7.4.59 (hrasvaḥ) and 7.4.60 (halādiḥ śeṣaḥ) leave each other a site and end identically (gADgADe → gagADe either way); Pāṇini's own sūtra order puts 7.4.59 first (Art. 21 पूर्व). Authentic prakriyās and Vidyut reorder them; that is a later teaching convention, not the Aṣṭādhyāyī.
